topics.text: Trump downplays Nvidia executive affair with alleged Chinese spy, says US spies on China too
NPR's Jennifer Pack reports China's Commerce Ministry condemns new US restrictions on high-end chip access
White House withdraws nominee Heidi Overton for FDA commissioner, leaving agency without confirmed leader
Senator Bill Cassidy criticizes White House for abandoning Overton's FDA confirmation path
Texas officials identify man fatally shot by Border Patrol agent in Laredo as Ernesto Quintana
S&P 500 falls nearly a quarter percent, extending five-day losing streak
El Salvador's Nayib Bukele says troops demolished home of Haitian gang leader
Recovery continues in Pakistan communities still reeling from August flood that killed over 1,500
Coyotes already using new wildlife crossing over US 101 in Los Angeles area ahead of October opening
